_comment: Example for scripts/step-captions.py: a 9:16 reel's step cards in the Mister Blocks grammar (the Instafill Product Hunt reel, 2026-11-24). Copy into projects/<id>/; outdir is beside the spec. 2-6 words a card; '*...*' is the accent, '|' forces the line break. For a 16:9 film beside a phone set canvas [1920,1080], cx 1280 (the empty right half), size 68, bottom 430.
